title: Course map and how to learn

clips.caption: This course follows the open source project Signal processing roadmap; we borrow its chapter skeleton and topics.
The original repository supplies the topic order; the walkthroughs, notebooks, exercises and figures here are newly written, not a translation or a mirror.
The <emphasis level="strong">course map</emphasis> has 16 weeks in two halves, foundations and applications; we start with Week 1.
Each subsection is one <emphasis level="strong">learning unit</emphasis> with its own notebook, kernel and separate workspace.

Follow the steps: read, edit, run. Hands-on exercises are yours to do, then continue. After a <emphasis level="strong">Stop</emphasis> you can <emphasis level="strong">replay</emphasis> from the current step.
